run.exit_code_meaning: 2 is the code the harness gives when a selected class could not run: the real-model smoke needs a provider credential this environment does not have, and the run is not faked.

not_run.reason: the protocol requires at least one real supported provider under a declared model, version and parameter set, and to record its cost; no real provider credential is configured in this environment, and the run would spend money. A mock-only success is insufficient under the protocol, so this class is reported as NOT RUN and is not counted as a pass.
